query:
UPDATE machines
            SET reference = $2, ipv4 = COALESCE($3, ipv4),
                state = CASE WHEN state = 'creating' THEN 'ready' ELSE state END,
                updated_at = CASE WHEN state = 'creating' THEN now() ELSE updated_at END
          WHERE id = $1 AND state IN ('creating', 'waking')
